extension.summary: Films and TV with Trakt, TMDB and Premiumize
extension.description: SpongeTV brings Trakt syncing, TMDB metadata, Premiumize and your own provider packages together in one add-on. This is a stage 4 test build: browsing, metadata, Trakt, provider packages and playback through Premiumize.
extension.disclaimer: SpongeTV includes no content providers. You are responsible for the provider packages you install.
extension.news: 1.3.0: Release 2, stage 3. Tools, Premiumize now has My Premiumize cloud: browse your folders and videos, play them, delete them from the context menu (after asking), with the space used by your cloud and the SpongeTV folder at the top. A new tidy-up, off by default (Settings, Accounts, Premiumize), deletes anything in the SpongeTV folder older than 7 to 90 days (30 unless changed) once a day, and clears that folder's finished transfers; nothing outside it is touched. In Source Select only the details line now scrolls. 1.2.3: "Search for sources again" and "Play next episode" in the context menu no longer ask "Resume from…" twice: Kodi's own question is turned off for them, leaving SpongeTV's, which uses your resume point from Trakt. 1.2.2: Release 2, stage 2, part 2. When a search finds nothing ready to play, SpongeTV offers to have Premiumize download the best torrent it hasn't cached (by your sort order and filter), to wait for or download in the background; this works with Hide sources Premiumize hasn't cached on. In Source Select, the highlighted source's release name and details scroll when they're too long, and the details now start with the pack type and seeds, then tags such as HDR.
